hack.root_cause: Flash loan + spot price manipulation during stablecoin minting
hack.description: Elephant Money lost $22.2M when an attacker used a flash loan to manipulate ELEPHANT's price during TRUNK stablecoin minting — a vulnerability Solidity Finance had identified in an audit but never communicated to the team.
